title: Package manifest (package.json)
description: The parts of an npm package.json that intlang reads. Read statically; no package code runs. Fields marked 'deferred' are reserved for features outside the first milestone and are rejected by a v0 implementation if present.

name.description: npm package name; with the version it forms the canonical package identity npm:<name>.
Import name: `import <name>` resolves to this package through spec.lock when exactly one locked package declares it.

entry.description: Package-relative path of the spec source that exports kinds, implementations, checks, generators, annotations and catalog declarations.

skills.description: Skill name -> package-relative folder. Each skill is exported as a catalog declaration of that name.

provides.description: Capability name -> (export name -> declaration in the entry module). A namespace, not a behavioural contract.

options.description: Name of a type in the entry module that `use ... for <capability> { ... }` options must satisfy. Absent: options are an error.

migrations.description: Package-relative path of a declarative upgrade map (field and output renames between versions).

bindings.description: deferred: capabilities for which the entry module defines a `binding`.
